candidates.title: As the Deer

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: As the deer panteth for the water,
So my soul longs after Thee.
You alone are my heart's desire,
And I long to be close to Thee.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: You are my refuge, my rock, my shield,
I will trust in You forever,
Lord, I will sing Your praise.

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: You are the breath of life,
You are the love that never ends,

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: As the deer panteth for the water,
So my soul longs after Thee.

candidates.notes: These lyrics are from general knowledge and every line/section must be checked against the chosen video.
